Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Petersburg Area Office Petersburg, AK 99833

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: April 14, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Tom Kowalske Petersburg Assistant Area Management Biologist thomas.kowalske@alaska.gov (907) 772-3801

ANITA BAY TERMINAL HARVEST AREA FISHERIES ANNOUNCEMENT

The Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (SSRAA) is forecasting total runs of 397,000 summer chum, 6,800 Chinook, and 14,700 coho salmon for the Anita Bay release site in 2026. It is anticipated that 148,000 summer chum, 6,100 Chinook, and 6,600 coho salmon will be available for common property harvest in the Anita Bay Terminal Harvest Area (THA).

The Anita Bay THA will be open continuously to harvest salmon with troll gear from 12:01 a.m., Monday, June 1, through 11:59 p.m., Tuesday, November 10. The Anita Bay THA will be open to harvest salmon with drift gillnet and purse seine gear concurrently from 5:00 a.m., Monday, June 1, through 12:00 noon, Friday, June 12, then on a rotational basis from 12:00 noon, Saturday, June 13, through 12:00 noon, Monday, August 31, then concurrently from 12:01 a.m., Tuesday, September 1, through 11:59 p.m., Tuesday, November 10. The Anita Bay THA will close for the season at 11:59 p.m., Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

The Anita Bay THA consists of those waters of Anita Bay south and west of a line from the tip of Anita Point at 56°13.68′ N lat, 132°22.48′ W long to a point on the northern shore at 56°14.26′ N lat, 132°23.93′ W long.

As described in 5 AAC 33.383(b)(1), from 12:01 a.m., Monday, June 15, through 11:59 p.m., Friday, July 10, waters within 0.25 nautical mile of the northern shoreline of Anita Bay west of a line from 56°12.33′ N lat, 132°26.19′ W long to 56°12.06′ N lat, 132°26.19′ W long and east of a line from 56°11.96′ N lat, 132°29.57′ W long to 56°11.73′ N lat, 132°29.36′ W long will be open.

Waters closed to commercial salmon fishing within the Anita Bay THA include:

(1) from 5:00 a.m., Monday, June 1, through 12:00 noon, Friday, June 12, the waters of the Anita Bay THA north and east of a line from 56°12.90′ N lat, 132°24.51′ W long to 56°12.75′ N lat, 132°23.50′ W long will be closed to the harvest of salmon with commercial purse seine and drift gillnet gear; (2) waters south and west of the waters described in 5 AAC 33.383(b)(1):

a. from Monday, June 15, through Thursday, June 25, the waters of the Anita Bay THA west of 132°26.19′

W long will be closed to the harvest of salmon;

b. from Friday, June 26, through Wednesday, July 1, the waters of the Anita Bay THA west of 132°26.98′ W

long will be closed to the harvest of salmon;

c. and from Thursday, July 2, through Friday, July 10, the waters of the Anita Bay THA west of 132°28.00′ W

long will be closed to the harvest of salmon.
